description:
Walk fiber ancestry on event dispatch:
- Capture phase: root → target (each ancestor, in order, runs its capture handler if registered).
- Target phase: target's bubble handler (and any other handler at the target).
- Bubble phase: target → root (each ancestor's bubble handler).
- `stop_propagation` halts the walk after the current handler.

Returns the handler results plus any pending side effects (state setters, observable writes, etc.).

## Acceptance
- Tests for capture-only, bubble-only, mixed, and stop_propagation behaviours.
- Tests with a multi-level fiber tree to verify root-to-target and target-to-root ordering.
- No web/Phoenix coupling in Core's dispatch logic.
title: Phase 3.2: Filament.Core.dispatch_event walker
